en: A sepia-toned interior scene of a traditional inn or café with wooden beamed ceiling, paneled walls, and simple wooden tables and chairs. A tall tiled stove stands near the back wall, and a small upright piano is placed beside a decorated Christmas tree. There is a cabinet or sideboard with curtains on the right and large windows letting in light on the left. The overall style suggests an early-20th‑century Central European guesthouse or tavern.
